**Mount Jack wildfire north of Sooke still out of control: CBC**
The Mount Jack wildfire on southern Vancouver Island, north of Sooke, is still classified as out of control by the B.C. Wildfire Service, CBC reports. It was discovered on September 20 and has grown to at least 210 hectares. Part of the Galloping Goose Trail has been closed as a precaution.
Source: https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/british-columbia/mount-jack-wildfire-remains-out-of-control-9.7297493?cmp=rss

**Demko placed on injured reserve with hip injury: Yardbarker**
Thatcher Demko has been placed on injured reserve with a hip injury, and the expectation now is that he will not be ready to start the 2026-27 season, Yardbarker reports. The Canucks had already said he would not be a full participant at training camp, with Kevin Lankinen expected to start in his place.
